title: Access-gated composition: zeroTrustGate applied attaches originRequest.access.aud; absent omits the block
asA: shelf consumer applying edge-cloudflare-tunnel v1.0.0 alongside edge-cloudflare-access v1.0.0
iWant: every ingress rule to attach an originRequest.access block naming the Access AUD when zeroTrustGate is applied and to omit the block when it is not
soThat: the shape switches purely on the applied capability set and never silently degrades

acceptanceCriteria.description: aud-presence-check probe reads each variant sidecar and asserts the ingress rules attach originRequest.access.aud on the access-gated variant and omit the block on the public-hostname variant. The shape flip is a pure function of the sidecar contents.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture ships the access-gated and public-hostname sidecar variants under packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/hetzner-throwaway-server/cloudflared/ with the access-gated sidecar carrying an elicited AUD
acceptanceCriteria.when: the aud-presence-check probe reads each variant sidecar's ingress rules
acceptanceCriteria.then: the access-gated variant ingress rules all carry originRequest.access.aud and the public-hostname variant ingress rules all omit the originRequest.access block; the shape flip is a pure function of the sidecar contents

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the access-gated variant on an account-bound run, when a request reaches the gated hostname with no Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header, cloudflared refuses at the edge and the origin never sees the request (the origin origin-hit counter stays at zero across N+1 requests).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the account-bound fixture with an origin counter behind a gated hostname
acceptanceCriteria.when: a client fires N+1 requests without a Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header
acceptanceCriteria.then: every request is refused at the edge and the origin counter stays at zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the access-gated variant, when a request reaches the gated hostname with a malformed or expired Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion, cloudflared refuses at the edge and the origin origin-hit counter stays at zero across N+1 requests.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the account-bound fixture with an origin counter behind a gated hostname
acceptanceCriteria.when: a client fires N+1 requests with a malformed or expired Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
acceptanceCriteria.then: every request is refused at the edge and the origin counter stays at zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the access-gated variant with an elicited AUD tag, when a request presents a well-signed Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion whose aud claim does not match the elicited AUD, cloudflared refuses at the edge and the origin origin-hit counter stays at zero.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the account-bound fixture with the elicited AUD tag configured
acceptanceCriteria.when: a client fires a request with a well-signed JWT whose aud claim mismatches the elicited AUD
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is refused at the edge and the origin counter stays at zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the access-gated variant, when a request presents a well-signed Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion whose aud claim matches the elicited AUD, the request reaches the origin exactly once and the origin origin-hit counter increments by one per accepted request.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the account-bound fixture with the elicited AUD tag configured and an origin counter
acceptanceCriteria.when: a client fires N requests each with a well-signed JWT whose aud matches the elicited AUD
acceptanceCriteria.then: each request reaches the origin and the origin counter reads exactly N
